talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 24 solo PCPs winding down in Kentucky; 3 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Lexington 40509, Hopkinsville 42240, Glasgow 42141) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~3,334 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Greenup County, Bourbon County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 15 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~56,400 patients across 47 at-risk practices statewide.
